_comment: Real events in and around Dehradun for Nov-Dec 2026, researched 2026-11-01 with sources. Coordinates are the city/town centre unless a venue is known. Excluded: events without a confirmed 2026 date (e.g. Mussoorie Winterline Carnival).

events.title: Virasat - The Festival of India (31st edition)
events.organizer: REACH (Rural Entrepreneurship for Art & Cultural Heritage)
events.description: A 15-day festival of music, dance and craft from across India, with a crafts bazaar, regional food and a vintage car and bike rally, open to all.

events.title: Diwali (Deepawali)
events.description: Diwali is listed as a public holiday in Uttarakhand on Sunday, 8 November 2026 (per a published holiday list, not the official gazette).

events.title: Uttarakhand Foundation Day (Uttarakhand Diwas)
events.description: Uttarakhand's state foundation day, observed every year on 9 November since the state was formed in 2000. No 2026 programme or venue had been announced at the time of listing.

events.title: Igas Bagwal (Budhi Diwali)
events.description: A Uttarakhand festival held on Ekadashi, the 11th day after Deepawali. Sources differ on the 2026 date (19 or 20 November); confirm locally.

events.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti
events.description: Guru Nanak Jayanti is listed as a public holiday in Uttarakhand on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 (per a published holiday list, not the official gazette).

events.title: Dehradun Literature Festival 2026 (8th edition)
events.description: The festival's eighth edition, themed 'Life. Literature. Legacy.', with talks, book sessions, poetry, music, theatre and workshops for writers, poets, artists and readers.

events.title: Kavishala Dehradun Meetup - November 2026
events.description: A two-hour community meetup (1:00-3:00 PM) for poets, writers and literature lovers, with poetry, storytelling and open-mic performances.

events.title: Mussoorie Ultra 2nd Edition
events.description: A trail ultra-run in Mussoorie's hills starting at 5:30 AM, with challenging trails and panoramic mountain views.

events.title: Christmas Day
events.description: Christmas Day is a public holiday in Uttarakhand on Friday, 25 December 2026.
